Different composition from previous school illustrations. No children, flags, rankings, logos or text.

edits.purpose: Ampliar encuadre para conservar edificios completos al recortar a 1200×630.
edits.prompt: Edit this MEE editorial miniature only to widen the framing: move the camera about 35 percent farther away so all three school buildings, roofs and chimneys are fully visible with large clear margins on every side. Keep the same three schools, colors, diagonal street, materials and lighting. All essential buildings must fit inside the central 65 percent of image height so the result can be cropped to a wide 1200 by 630 cover without cutting roofs or facades. No text, logos, people or new main buildings. Preserve the distinctive crafted scene.
